_readme: HOMEPAGE HERO CAROUSEL — deck source for <HomeHeroCarousel /> (2026-06-18).
This file defines the DECK: slide order, links, and the DEFAULT image and
text for each slide. Each slide's `id` is its stable override key.
RESOLUTION (single source, no flipping): the component resolves each slide
field as  published CMS override  ->  the default in this file. Overrides
live in pi.cms_image_slots / pi.cms_text_fields under entity_type='page',
entity_slug='home-hero', field_path='slide.<id>.image' (and .headline,
.dispatch, .label, .hours). There is NO article-hero derivation and NO
page/home cover.image involved.
EDIT ON THE FLY: in edit mode, right-click a slide photo to replace it, or
click its headline/standfirst/tag to edit. Changes persist for all
visitors immediately (BaseLayout hydration) and bake into the static build
on the next deploy. Reordering or adding/removing slides here is safe —
overrides follow the slide `id`, never the position. Keep ids unique (the
build throws on duplicates). primaryHref/primaryLabel are deck-only (edit
them here, not in edit mode).
To change a DEFAULT image: put the file in next/public/images/sourced/ and
update the `image` path here.
LEGIBILITY: a warm-dark tint behind the text keeps the headline readable on
any photo. For an unusually bright/pale image, add an optional per-slide
`"scrim": <number>` (default 1) to dial the tint up (e.g. 1.25) or down for
an already-dark photo (e.g. 0.8).
AUTOMATION (autofix crons, image-relevance passes, accuracy scans): this
file is LOCKED. Do not modify it.

slides.label: FEATURE
slides.imageAlt: Sorrento foreshore at dusk, winter solstice festival evening, Mornington Peninsula 2026
slides.headline: The Sorrento Solstice Festival: A Night When the Peninsula Burns.
slides.dispatch: The longest night of the year deserves a proper send-off. Two days on the Sorrento foreshore, a six-metre effigy on the bay, and the particular magic of a winter festival done right. Saturday 20 June.

slides.label: SLOW PENINSULA
slides.imageAlt: Flinders Pier and Bass Strait at dusk, with the village behind
slides.headline: The other Peninsula weekend.
slides.dispatch: When Red Hill is booked out and Sorrento feels like a queue, Flinders offers another version of the Peninsula weekend — south of everything, closer to the ocean, and slower on purpose.

slides.label: FEATURE
slides.imageAlt: Winter solstice figure on the Sorrento foreshore at dusk, the ferry crossing behind
slides.headline: A winter Peninsula weekend.
slides.dispatch: Short days, empty dining rooms, a fire in every cellar door with a hearth, and a coast that looks like a different country in a southerly. The Peninsula in winter is its most underrated season.

slides.label: WALK
slides.imageAlt: Coastal scrub along the Range Area Walk at Point Nepean
slides.headline: When the light starts improving.
slides.dispatch: Bushrangers Bay for a full reset. Cape Schanck boardwalk when time is short. Sorrento Back Beach for mood rather than route. The four walks that earn the second drink.

slides.label: FEATURE
slides.imageAlt: Surfers walking along an ocean beach below coastal scrub, Mornington Peninsula
slides.headline: The Hatted Restaurants of the Peninsula.
slides.dispatch: Four two-hat restaurants. Seven one-hat tables. Barragunda is the debut, Tedesca took Regional Restaurant of the Year, and Laura is still where the long lunch happens. The complete list, with booking realities.

slides.label: GUIDE
slides.imageAlt: Cape Schanck lighthouse above the basalt clifftop coastline, Mornington Peninsula National Park
slides.headline: The lighthouse at the edge of everything.
slides.dispatch: The 1859 limestone lighthouse, the boardwalk to Pulpit Rock, and the walk to Bushrangers Bay. The grounds are free from 6am. Here is the full structure of the day.
